title: Scenario CLI Manifest
description: Declarative contract for a scenario's CLI command surface. Single source of truth for command groups, commands, arg shapes, governance metadata, and the proto-method bindings each command invokes. Resolved at scenario.well_known_paths.cli_manifest in .vrooli/repo-contract.json. Consumed by packages/cli-core/cliapp/LoadFromManifest (registers commands) and by prompt-manager (derives action certainty from governance).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete. Has no runtime effect.

name.description: Scenario or CLI display name (matches scenarios/<name>).

omitted.description: RPCs intentionally not exposed as CLI commands. Each entry documents one (service, method) pair with a reason. RequireProtoServiceCoverage treats these as covered.

bind.description: Maps the flag's parsed value onto a specific proto request field via the named decoding strategy. Consumed by generic dispatchers (protodispatch) so hand-rolled handlers are not required for file-bearing or JSON-payload flags.

field.description: snake_case proto field name on the RPC request message.

kind.description: Decoding strategy. raw_string: value used verbatim as a string field. json_inline: value parsed as a JSON literal into the target message field. json_file: value treated as a filesystem path, file contents JSON-decoded into the target message field.

service.description: Proto service name, e.g. NotesService. Must match a service in the bound proto descriptor.

method.description: Proto method name, e.g. ListNotes. Must match a method on the named service.

effect.description: Side-effect classification. read = no observable mutation; write = mutates state non-destructively; destructive = irreversible mutation or data loss.

run_eligible.description: Whether prompt-manager actions may invoke this command. False = command exists for human/CLI use only.

requires_confirmation.description: Whether the runner must prompt for confirmation. Defaults to true when effect == destructive.

Measure.description: Declares the command as a Measure: a named, typed, parameterized analytical query that search-hub can semantically match from a natural-language question, fill deterministically where possible, and (for read-only measures at high confidence) execute and answer directly. Curated prose lives here; param types/enums/bounds are NEVER duplicated — they are derived from the bound proto request message (the descriptor reader in packages/measures-go). A command's governance.effect/run_eligible gate auto-execution.

intent.description: One-line description of what the measure answers. Used as grounding for semantic matching.

domain.description: Optional stateful-domain override. Defaults to the command's group name. measures-health uses the domain to grade coverage (one domain ↦ ≥1 measure).

questions.description: Natural-language phrasings this measure answers. These are the embedding key for semantic matching — author several real phrasings.

params.description: Per-parameter curated overlay keyed by the proto request field name (snake_case). Carries ONLY what the proto descriptor cannot express — a presentation default, a dynamic-enum values_source, or a canonical type annotation. Types/enum membership/numeric bounds come from proto, never here.

type.description: Optional canonical-convention annotation the proto kind cannot imply. The only legal upgrade is marking a plain string field as a dynamic 'enum' (paired with values_source), or 'time_window' when the proto field is the shared vrooli.measures.v1.TimeWindow. Leave empty to let the proto-derived type stand. cli-health flags an unknown annotation.

default.description: Fallback token/value used when a question does not name the parameter (e.g. 'this_week' for a time_window).

values_source.description: Names a runtime values callback the owning scenario supplies for a dynamic enum (e.g. 'initiative_names' ↦ live initiative names).

MeasureResult.description: How the measure's answer is shaped and presented.

kind.description: scalar = a single value (a count); table = a set of rows; series = ordered (time, value) points.

value_field.description: Names the field in the measure result that carries the answer (for scalar) or the primary column (for table/series). Mandatory.

unit.description: Human label for the value ('items', 'hours'). Optional.

summary_template.description: One-line answer template with {placeholders} filled from the result + resolved params, e.g. '{count} backlog items completed ({window})'.

Measures.description: Scenario-level measures metadata: the waiver list for stateful domains intentionally not covered by any measure, and an optional statefulness-classification override. measures-health (a later phase) reads these when grading coverage.

omitted.description: Stateful domains intentionally left without a measure, each with a reason. measures-health treats these as waived (not an ERROR); a waiver pointing at a non-stateful/nonexistent domain is a stale WARNING.

domains.description: Optional statefulness-classification overrides — the escape hatch when domain inference misclassifies. measures-health leads with inference; an entry here forces a domain's stateful flag.

stateful.description: Force whether this domain is treated as stateful (countable persisted rows ↦ a measure is expected) or not.
